source.dataset_name: Chan-Lam coupling of primary sulfonamides with boronic acids

reaction_class: Chan-Lam coupling of primary sulfonamides with boronic acids

meta.evidence: First, the catalysts (2 umol per vial) and solid bases (20 umol per vial) were added by dosing 50 uL each of a stock solution in 1,2-dichloroethane (40 mM for catalysts, 0.4 M for bases) via single-channel pipette.

First, the catalysts (2 umol per vial) and solid bases (20 umol per vial) were added by dosing 50 uL each of a stock solution in 1,2-dichloroethane (40 mM for catalysts, 0.4 M for bases) via single-channel pipette.
The 1,2-dichloroethane was then removed via centrifugal evaporation using a Genevac EZ-2 evaporator (Scientific Products)(method: low boiling point, maximum temperature of 30 C, 10-30 minutes).

Stock solutions of sulfonamide and boronic acid (0.1 M in sulfonamide, 0.15 M in boronic acid) were prepared in the respective reaction solvent (MeCN, MeOH, DCE, or EtOAc) and 100 uL were dosed into the reaction plate according to the design.

Stock solutions of sulfonamide and boronic acid (0.1 M in sulfonamide, 0.15 M in boronic acid) were prepared in the respective reaction solvent (MeCN, MeOH, DCE, or EtOAc) and 100 uL were dosed into the reaction plate according to the design.

Stock solutions of sulfonamide and boronic acid (0.1 M in sulfonamide, 0.15 M in boronic acid) were prepared in the respective reaction solvent (MeCN, MeOH, DCE, or EtOAc) and 100 uL were dosed into the reaction plate according to the design.
Lastly, liquid bases were dispensed manually via single-channel pipette.
The reaction block was sealed and the contents were tumble-stirred at ~600 rpm (3-Position Magnetic Tumble Stirrer, U.S. Series, V&P Scientific, Inc.) for 18 hours at 60 C.
After the reaction time had elapsed, the plate was removed from the heat.
Upon cooling, 500 uL of biphenyl stock solution (0.05 M in MeCN, 0.25 equiv) was added to each well as external standard.

Taking care not to agitate the solution, 25 uL from each well was sampled via multi-channel pipettor and dispensed into a Thermo Scientific(TM) 96-well 1 mL polypropylene plate (SKU 278743) for analysis.
Each well was diluted with 750 uL MeCN and sealed using a PlateLoc Thermal Microplate Sealer, then subjected to UPLC-MS analysis.

unresolved: The procedure states that both catalysts and solid bases were initially dosed, but no supplied component is explicitly identified as a solid base. The supplied component r1 is aligned to the later literal phrase "liquid bases".

The procedure describes multiple reaction solvents and states that dosing occurred "according to the design"; assignment of r6 to literal "DCE" is based on its supplied identity, but the specific design entry is not provided.
The source specifies an evaporation duration range of "10-30 minutes", which cannot be represented as a single duration_s value without selecting a value.
The source gives aliquot and dilution volumes in uL; these were not converted because only mL, mg, and mmol are permitted for explicit Add amounts.
